constraints: Every provenance and value field describes the result keyed by publication_id + result_id. Never join provenance or raw values on publication_id alone.
One row per metric, device, conditions, aggregation and source occurrence. Separate forward/reverse, champion/mean and different time points.
A cited result has a citation; its local device_id and measurement_id are empty. Attach a primary result only where the device and measurement links are supported.
Keep the original raw_value and raw_unit; normalized_value and normalized_unit describe the same occurrence.
If more than one result could own a source or value, retain the alternatives and needs_clarification; do not manufacture the link.
